stemMd: All packages sent by the express service receive electronic tracking. Some tracked packages are sent by the economy service. Package Vela was sent express. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every tracked package was sent express.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Package Vela arrives sooner than every economy package.

explanationMd: Apply the stated one-way rule directly to Vela. The presence of tracked economy packages prevents reversing the implication.

distractorRationale.a: The economy-service counterexamples explicitly rule this out.
distractorRationale.c: Express status does not imply economy status.
distractorRationale.d: Some tracked economy packages are explicitly given.
